text: Drennan connects promissory estoppel with revocation: reliance can keep a subcontractor’s offer open even though no bilateral subcontract has yet formed. Contrast James Baird and the distinct protection for beginning invited performance under Restatement § 45.
sourceSummary: Reasonable reliance on a subcontractor’s bid protected the general contractor’s opportunity to accept it after winning the main contract, even though using the bid was not itself acceptance.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
